title: A Dash of Sunshine
summary: A wheelchair bound woman is found strangled with her own scarf.
method: It was a criss-cross plot; the killer and his accomplice made an arrangement to kill each other's targets. The killer faked food poisoning to establish an alibi.
motive: The killers did it for money. They met at an AA meeting and hatched a plan. The first victim in England had an insurance payout, the current victim had an inheritance that would go to her sister.
killer: Will Teague's friend Ronnie and DI Poole's former colleague, Doug Anderson
notes: The actor playing DI Parker plays one of the suspects - Will Teague.
